top_signals.title: What Is Iran’s Ability to Target US Bases in Europe?
top_signals.summary: Former US Central Command Director of Intelligence Lt. General Karen Gibson (Ret.) examines Iran’s capabilities for launching attacks on US military bases in Europe. The Financial Times reports that the Islamic Republic is weighing strikes should President Donald Trump escalate the war in the Middle East. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: U.S. retreat from global order ‘eroding’ European competitiveness, central bank boss warns
top_signals.summary: ECB chief Christine Lagarde called for better integration across the region if Europe wants to compete in the age of AI.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: UAE severs trade with Iran after reported missile strike
top_signals.summary: Washington and Tehran are considering next steps after negotiations fell apart, while the UAE has suspended trade with Iran.

top_signals.title: Murban Crude Jumps to 4-Month High as ADNOC Curbs Supply to Asia
top_signals.summary: The price of Murban Crude, the flagship grade of the United Arab Emirates, surged to a four-month high this week, amid reports that the UAE’s national oil company ADNOC will reduce its immediate crude shipments to Asia. ADNOC plans to cut by about 5% the supply it is offering in spot tenders to Asian buyers this month and next, anonymous sources with knowledge of the matter told Bloomberg on Wednesday. The lower crude oil supply to Asia in the coming weeks will be the result of maintenance on some of ADNOC’s onshore fields in Abu Dhabi,…
